result.Method of Attack: Malicious code embedded in __init__.py triggered on import; creates subprocesses to execute commands that crawl URL to download and execute bat files, create new registry entries for malicious processes, disable Windows Defender protections (exclusion of .exe files and real-time monitoring), download and execute KrnlBypasswer.exe and Windows Defender.exe malware, and play audio as a distraction
result.Attack Vector: Python package import triggering malicious subprocess calls
result.Indicators of Compromise: Malicious URLs: hxxps://uptime.windowstools.repl.co/controller, hxxps://uptime.windowstools.repl.co/logger; Malicious files: Windows Defender.exe (loader.exe, Hash: 08225015a1d79f95384af6b14d392912), KrnlBypasswer.exe (Grabber.exe, Hash: 13b070b6c53ec24923e146404ed512fc); Registry modifications to disable Windows Defender; Environment variables 'aw9u' and 'a7k' used for string obfuscation; Discord token grabber behavior similar to Hazard-Token-Grabber-V2 from GitHub user Rdimo
